title: microstegia serrulata
intro: Microstegia serrulata, commonly known as the Thistle of the desert, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage.
